description: From Shodan's pre-collected passive scan data: whether TCP port 22 was seen open on an IPv4 address and any OpenSSH version identified in its software (CPE) list. This is passive and may be days old; it is not a live SSH banner grab or algorithm audit. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_ssh_banner_audit
